fields.description: Master switch. When disabled no archiving runs.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Automatically archive data older than the current fiscal year once per day (background job).
fields.label: Auto Archive Daily

fields.description: Block archive until last_backup_id and last_backup_checksum are set (PRE-006).
fields.label: Require Backup Reference

fields.description: Rows copied per batch. Lower values keep locks shorter on busy sites.
fields.label: Batch Size

fields.description: Pick the last closed fiscal year to move out of live tables (e.g. 2025). Everything through the end of that year is archived; the current year stays live. This sets the cutoff date automatically.
fields.label: Archive Through Fiscal Year

fields.description: Advanced: only rows before this date are archived. Usually filled from Archive Through Fiscal Year. Leave empty to auto-use the start of the current fiscal year.
fields.label: Archive Cutoff Date

fields.description: Identifier of the verified database/files backup taken before archive.
fields.label: Last Backup ID

fields.description: Checksum or restore-test status of that backup.
fields.label: Last Backup Checksum

fields.description: User must type this phrase to confirm archive (maker control).
fields.label: Confirmation Phrase

fields.default: Preview/Browse: Archive Manager, Accounts Manager, Stock Manager, System Manager.\nArchive/Restore/Config: Archive Manager, System Manager.\nAudit Log: read for managers; append-only (no delete).
fields.label: Roles
